template_meta.proposing_department: Human Resources / Learning and Development Center

business_background.summary: Training plans, course enrollment, learning records, exam results, and certificates are currently scattered across email, spreadsheets, and several platforms. Training admins struggle to track execution, learners lack one learning entry point, and management lacks analyzable training effectiveness data.
pain_points: Training plan publishing and enrollment rely on manual notifications
Course resources are scattered and learning progress is hard to track consistently
Exam results, certificates, and learning profiles are not archived automatically
Training data definitions are inconsistent and reporting takes too much manual work

objectives: Create one entry point for training plans, courses, and learning
Support closed-loop management of enrollment, learning, exams, and certificates
Improve training execution efficiency and learning record accuracy
Build analyzable training data for talent development decisions
metrics: Reduce course enrollment processing time by 50%
Automatically generate and archive 90% of certificates
Reduce manual training report preparation by 60%

out_scope: Building the underlying live classroom engine from scratch
Deep content procurement from external university platforms

target_roles: Learner: browse courses, enroll in training, study content, take exams, and view certificates
Instructor: maintain teaching materials, view learner lists, and review feedback
Training administrator: create plans, manage enrollment, configure exams and certificates
Department owner: approve team enrollment and view team learning progress
Management: view coverage, completion, pass rate, and training effectiveness metrics
System administrator: maintain permissions, categories, dictionaries, and base configuration
core_scenarios: A training administrator publishes a training plan and opens enrollment to the target audience.
A learner selects a course in the training portal, submits enrollment, and receives notifications.
A department owner approves team member enrollment, and the system updates enrollment status.
A learner completes online learning and takes an assessment.
The system generates a certificate based on completion rules and stores the learning profile.
Management reviews completion rate, exam pass rate, and course feedback.

functional_requirements.overview: This requirement covers seven capability groups: course resources, training plans, enrollment approval, learning progress, exams and assessments, certificates and learning profiles, and analytics.

features.description: Maintain course categories, course information, content materials, instructors, and target audiences.
features.trigger: A training administrator creates or updates a course.
logic: Support course publishing, unpublishing, categories, tags, and target role maintenance
Support videos, documents, assignments, and other content attachments
Support course versions and update history
features.inputs: Course name, category, instructor, content, target audience
features.exceptions: Duplicate courses, missing content, deletion blocked when referenced by a plan

features.description: Publish training plans and manage enrollment, approval, quotas, and notifications.
features.trigger: A plan is created or an enrollment is submitted.
logic: Support enrollment by organization, role, or named people
Support quota control, waitlists, cancellation, and approval flows
Support enrollment, approval, and class-start notifications
features.inputs: Plan name, course, schedule, quota, audience, approver
features.outputs: Training plan, enrollment list, approval result
features.exceptions: Quota full, deadline passed, duplicate enrollment, approval timeout

features.description: Provide one learning entry point and record learning progress.
logic: Support course catalog, learning progress, duration, and completion status
Support resume learning, mandatory/elective markers, and reminders
features.inputs: Learner, course, content, duration, completion status
features.outputs: Learning record, progress statistics, completion proof
features.exceptions: Content playback failure, progress reporting failure, duplicate record merge

features.description: Configure question banks, papers, exam sessions, grading, and score statistics.
features.trigger: A plan requires an exam or an admin publishes one.
logic: Support question bank, paper, exam time, and pass score settings
Support automatic grading, manual grading, and retakes
Support score lookup, pass-rate statistics, and export
features.inputs: Questions, paper, exam setup, answer records
features.outputs: Score sheet, pass status, exam statistics
features.exceptions: Exam timeout, duplicate submission, cheating flag, insufficient retake eligibility

features.description: Generate certificates based on completion and exam results, and build employee learning profiles.
features.trigger: A learner meets certificate issuance conditions.
logic: Support certificate templates, number rules, and validity periods
Support certificate generation, download, revocation, and expiry reminders
Aggregate learning and certificate records by employee
features.inputs: Completion record, score, certificate template, employee data
features.exceptions: Certificate generation failure, expiry, revocation audit trail

features.description: Provide statistics on training execution, learning effectiveness, and resource usage.
features.trigger: A manager or training admin views reports.
logic: Support coverage and completion statistics by organization, course, time, and role
Support pass rate, course rating, and feedback summary
Support report export and scheduled delivery
features.inputs: Enrollment records, learning records, scores, feedback
features.outputs: Training dashboard, statistical report, export file
features.exceptions: Data delay, insufficient permission, definition change reminder

pages.elements: Recommended courses, pending tasks, certificates, notifications
pages.actions: Search courses, enroll, continue learning, view certificates
pages.flow: A learner logs in, reviews tasks, and enters a course.

pages.elements: Course list, course detail, content, instructors, target audience
pages.actions: Create course, edit content, publish/unpublish, copy course
pages.flow: An admin maintains a course and publishes it to the visible audience.

pages.elements: Plan list, enrollment list, approval status, notifications
pages.actions: Publish plan, adjust quota, view enrollment, export list
pages.flow: An admin creates a plan, and the system opens enrollment by audience and sends notices.

pages.elements: Question bank, paper, exam setup, scores, certificate templates
pages.actions: Configure exam, grade, generate certificate, revoke certificate
pages.flow: After an exam ends, the system summarizes scores and generates certificates by rule.

pages.elements: Coverage, completion, pass rate, course rating, trends
pages.flow: Management reviews training effectiveness by organization and time.

rules: Enrollment is closed after the deadline by default; admins may add records with permission.
One learner can have only one active enrollment record for the same training plan.
Course completion can depend on progress, duration, assignment submission, and exam pass status.
Certificate numbers must be globally unique and cannot be reused after revocation.
Changes to scores and certificates must keep an audit trail.
key_data: Course: code, name, category, instructor, content, target audience, status
Training plan: code, course, schedule, quota, audience, approval rules
Enrollment record: learner, plan, status, approver, approval time
Learning record: learner, course, progress, duration, completion status, completion time
Exam score: exam, learner, score, pass status, grading status
Certificate: number, learner, course/plan, issue time, validity period, status

items: Access control: visibility and operations controlled by role, organization, and data scope.
Performance: common list queries return within 3 seconds; reports may be generated asynchronously.
Usability: key enrollment and learning flows need retry handling and clear error messages.
Audit: enrollment approval, score edits, and certificate generation/revocation must be logged.
Security: exam answers, scores, and certificate data must be managed as sensitive data.

risks: Inconsistent historical training data definitions may affect migration quality.
Different content formats and playback capabilities may affect learning experience.
Exam anti-cheating and certificate compliance requirements need early confirmation.
Unclear multi-organization permission boundaries may affect data isolation.
open_questions: Should training plans support cross-company or external learner enrollment?
Should course completion rules vary by course, plan, or role?
Do certificates require electronic seals, QR verification, or validity periods?
Do exams require time limits, random papers, anti-cheating, and retake rules?
Which training modules need independent pages in the final product?

milestones.acceptance: Confirm scope, roles, core flows, and reporting definitions
Complete main page prototypes and process review
Complete core feature development and external integrations
Launch pilot organization and close pilot issues
Complete full release, training, and acceptance
